scope: Frozen real-repository change review/investigation, with explicitly marked injected candidates; not full coding delivery or Unity performance
runtime: Codex 0.159.0-alpha.12.1 + official Python SDK source; native V1 lifecycle via narrow Responses tool-name mapping

conditions.single: One capable agent with complete public packet and normal self-check
conditions.single_plus: Same agent/thread gets explicit additional investigation and revision rounds, no extra agents
conditions.team_parallel: One coordinator + three native read-only investigators: rules, contracts/state, counterexamples/tests; same full packet; native parallel dispatch
conditions.team_serial: Same roles, packet and synthesis as team_parallel; wait for each before next spawn; no passing earlier child results to later child

sampling.confirmation_condition_selection: Freeze after development; run single/single_plus/team if technically valid; serial timing subset selected before confirmation outcomes
sampling.independent_unit: task; repeats measure stability, not new independent samples

criteria.primary: Correct actionable issues/critical misses and evidence-complete task delivery; judged against frozen oracle and reproducible code
criteria.false_positives: Unsupported claimed defects counted separately, duplicate findings do not inflate TP
criteria.resource_question: A vs team for absolute incremental quality/cost; A+ vs team for extra reasoning vs organization
criteria.time_question: Only same decomposition serial vs parallel supports parallel speed claim; include full run and synthesis
criteria.failures: Keep protocol/timeout/truncation/noncompliance and all assigned runs; do not silently drop or best-of

budget.reserve: Use conservative peak prices for request reservation; unknown outcomes retain reserved cost; actual usage reported separately
budget.authorization: User explicitly requested live validation and comparisons; bounded small research budget set autonomously, no new broad benchmark spend

price_snapshot.billing_claim: estimate from usage, not account invoice

data_rules: Tasks and oracle freeze before confirmation outputs; hashes saved
All modes see same full public source packet and instructions; oracle never sent to model
Only registered lifecycle and read-only evidence allowed; no generated shell or code writes
No fallback provider; API key in memory only; fresh CODEX_HOME
Protocol success is not quality improvement; this stage does not certify full product cancellation/resume
